T8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
One cell line, one drug, one receptor. Dexamethasone through GR is a fast nuclear-
receptor response and nothing here generalises to slower or indirect stimuli.
The half-time is a summary of a 16-point curve and it discards shape: an overshoot
and a monotone rise with the same midpoint are recorded identically. Overshoot is
the signature negative feedback is supposed to produce and this statistic cannot
see it, which understates what a feedback test could find.
Topology comes from CollecTRI curation on a different cell line. A two-cycle curated
in one context need not be wired in A549, and no gate here can see that.
Bulk RNA averages over a population, so a fast response in a subpopulation and a
slow one everywhere are the same curve.
T3 and T6 are declared and not run in this build. They are the promoter-level joins
of DNase and NR3C1 peaks to each gene's TSS, and they are the next step rather than
a result. Nothing in this loop's conclusion may lean on them.
